title: GRTeclyn research fork — colliding traversable wormholes
description:
Code, run matrix and packed campaign data behind Colliding Traversable Wormholes: Gravitational Waves and the Formation of Heavy Black Hole Seeds (N. M. Shirokov and I. Nachevsky, 2026).

A GRTeclyn (AMReX/GPU) research fork with a Python orchestration layer: constraint-solved and exactly boosted binaries of Ellis–Bronnikov drainholes held open by a ghost scalar, CCZ4 evolution with refinement boxes that follow the throats, a spectral MOTS finder, Weyl-scalar and scalar-flux extraction, and the analysis and figure scripts. Includes the parameter files and thinned diagnostic streams of every run, the run registry, the figures and the movies — reproducible without a GPU.
